entities.name: Bosh
entities.description: A golem of Mirrodin, companion of Glissa, who sought his lost memory and whose body slowly turned to flesh.

entities.name: Glissa
entities.description: Bosh's companion who summoned the Kaldra avatar.

entities.name: Memnarch
entities.description: Creator of Bosh who later took control of the Kaldra avatar.

entities.name: Slobad
entities.description: Goblin tinkerer who found Bosh and travelled with him; parts of Bosh were later used in his compleated form.

entities.name: Mycosynth
entities.description: Substance Bosh was tasked with clearing from Mirrodin's Core.

entities.name: Mirrodin's Core
entities.description: Heart of Mirrodin where Bosh's flesh transformation accelerated.

entities.name: Mephidross
entities.description: Toxic region where Bosh was abandoned and found by Slobad.

entities.name: Kaldra avatar
entities.description: Avatar summoned by Glissa that Memnarch controlled; it crushed Bosh.

entities.name: Praetors of New Phyrexia
entities.description: Rulers who incorporated parts of Bosh in Slobad's compleated form.

events.summary: Memnarch creates Bosh and tasks him with clearing mycosynth from the Core, which he fails.
events.quote: Bosh was created by Memnarch to help him with his duties and quests.

events.summary: Bosh is deactivated and abandoned in the Mephidross, where Slobad finds him.
events.quote: he was deactivated and abandoned in the Mephidross

events.summary: Bosh's memories are fully restored in the Pool of Knowledge.
events.quote: until his memories were fully restored by entering the Pool of Knowledge

events.summary: Glissa summons the Kaldra avatar, which Memnarch commandeers to capture her; Bosh takes her place and is crushed in Kaldra's grip.
events.quote: Bosh's fleshy body was crushed in Kaldra's giant grip.

events.summary: The praetors of New Phyrexia incorporate parts of Bosh into the compleated Slobad.
events.quote: The praetors of New Phyrexia incorporated parts of Bosh in the compleated form of Slobad .

relations.quote: Bosh was created by Memnarch to help him with his duties and quests.

relations.note: companion who sacrificed himself for her
relations.quote: Bosh saved his friend one last time

relations.note: crushed him in its grip under Memnarch's control
relations.quote: Bosh's fleshy body was crushed in Kaldra's giant grip.
